## What's new in 0.11.0

Microsoft Entra ID support is complete, plus a Windows build and a few fixes. No breaking
changes.

Full details are in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SolaceProducts/solace-broker-mcp/blob/v0.11.0/CHANGELOG.md).

### Added

- **Microsoft Entra ID support is complete.** Entra On-Behalf-Of no longer needs a feature
  flag, and the [Authentication Guide](https://github.com/SolaceProducts/solace-broker-mcp/blob/v0.11.0/docs/authentication.md)
  covers setting up Entra end to end.
- Windows (amd64) build: `solace-broker-mcp-<version>-windows-amd64.zip`, containing
  `solace-broker-mcp.exe`.

### Removed

- The `HOP2_JWT_BEARER_ENABLED` environment variable. The jwt-bearer grant type for
  `broker_oauth.grant_type` now works without it, so you can delete it. Rolling back to an
  earlier version needs it set to `true` again.

### Fixed

- `list-brokers` and `describe-semp-schema` now validate their input like every other tool,
  and report bad input as a readable tool error.
- The token-exchange audience-mismatch message is now logged at `INFO` instead of `WARN`, once
  per broker and audience, so Entra deployments no longer see it on every exchange.
- `create-queue-subscription` rejects topics containing HTML-encoded characters (such as
  `&gt;`) instead of subscribing to the wrong topic.
